local_smoke_validation._note: PIPELINE VALIDATION ONLY. Tiny config, byte-level tokenizer, CPython stdlib corpus, 20 s on Apple M1 CPU. NOT a track score and NOT comparable to any leaderboard number.
local_smoke_validation.config: 4L x 128d x 4H/2KV, mlp=2x, vocab=256 (byte-level), 492,690 params, ~40 steps, 20.2 s, Apple M1 CPU
local_smoke_validation.corpus: CPython 3.13 standard-library sources, 1.52 MB of real text
what_this_proves: the end-to-end path runs: tokenize -> train -> sliding eval -> quantise -> compress -> BPB -> artifact assertion
BPB denominator is correct: scored tokens (152,207) == scored bytes (152,207) under the byte-level tokenizer
quantisation moves BPB in the expected direction (worse), so the roundtrip is not silently broken
artifact packing works: 989,696 raw -> ~346.6 KB compressed -> ~397 KB total, far under 16 MB
what_this_does_not_prove: that TTDS is invalid -- 3/3 seeds agree in sign but the model is severely under-trained (40 steps) at 1/1000 the scale
that sliding-window eval works -- stride was fixed at 32 with no A/B

target.level_2_route: sliding-window evaluation at stride=64 on the unmodified baseline (no retraining needed)
target.level_4_route: SRD + TTDS on the full SOTA stack

technique_summary: Baseline stack: SP8192 + 11Lx512d/8H/4KV + MLP4x + LeakyReLU(0.5)^2 + Partial RoPE(16/64) + parallel residuals(L7+) + QK-Gain 5.25 + MuonEq-R + EMA 0.9965 + WD 0.095 + GPTQ int6/int8 SDClip + byte-shuffle/Brotli + sliding-window eval(stride=64) + legal score-first TTT.  MY ADDITIONS: [1] SRD - sample the depth-recurrence unroll count per step (extra in {1,2}) instead of fixing it at 2; [2] TTDS - unroll deeper at eval time (extra=3) at zero artifact bytes and zero training seconds, spending only the separate 600 s eval budget.

SRD_stochastic_recurrence_depth.what: per-step random sampling of the recurrence unroll count during training
SRD_stochastic_recurrence_depth.why: a shared (recurrent) block trained at a single fixed depth is only ever good at that one depth, which caps how far the free 'how many times do I unroll' knob can be pushed at eval time
SRD_stochastic_recurrence_depth.predicted_effect: slightly WORSE BPB on its own (+0.001 to +0.003) - it is insurance bought for TTDS, not a standalone win

TTDS_test_time_depth_scaling.what: unroll the recurrent block more times at eval than the training mean (17 -> 20 virtual layers)
TTDS_test_time_depth_scaling.why: parameters are shared so extra depth costs zero artifact bytes; training and evaluation have two separate 600 s budgets and the current SOTA uses only ~500 s of the eval budget
TTDS_test_time_depth_scaling.cost: 0 parameters, 0 artifact bytes, 0 training seconds; only eval wallclock
TTDS_test_time_depth_scaling.predicted_effect: clearly WORSE on its own (train/test depth mismatch); only expected to pay off when combined with SRD
